 Confusion over open enrollment: Medicare Monday
 More than 320,000 Minnesotans are learning their current health insurance plans might no longer be available as Medicare open enrollment begins through Dec.7. FOX 9’s All Day spoke with Kelli Jo Greiner of the Minnesota Board on Aging to answer viewer questions.
